meta.title: Ana Estreia's Portfolio
meta.description: Ana Estreia is a software developer with a postgraduate degree in Data Science, based in the Algarve, Portugal.

hero.name: Ana.
hero.titleAccessible: Hi, I'm Ana. I make sense of data.
hero.copy: I’m a software developer with a postgraduate degree in Data Science. I enjoy turning messy information into something clear and useful.

about.label: 01 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME
about.paragraph1: I’m a software developer with a BSc in Computer Engineering from the University of Algarve and a postgraduate degree in Data Science from the Polytechnic Institute of Portalegre.
about.paragraph2: Day to day, I work with APIs, SQL and mobile apps, which means moving data between systems and making sure it arrives clean. It’s the part I enjoy most, and the reason I went deeper into data.
about.paragraph3: Outside work, I follow developments in science and read... quite a lot.

experience.label: 02 / WHERE I’VE BEEN
experience.title: Experience
experience.bullet1: Extract and manipulate data from SQL databases and APIs to keep internal applications running on accurate, up-to-date information.
experience.bullet2: Built an automated data-extraction solution that replaced manual lookups for a consulting client.
experience.bullet3: Develop cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter, integrated with backend APIs.
experience.bullet4: Researched and prototyped integrations for internal projects.
experience.tutorSummary: Private tutoring for lower and upper-secondary students.

projects.label: 03 / SELECTED WORK
projects.title: Projects
projects.dataLinkAria: View Data Science coursework on GitHub
projects.dataDescription: Postgraduate practical work in data analysis and machine learning, including satellite wildfire analysis, prediction of students’ academic outcomes, and CNN and NLP classification experiments.
projects.extractionDescription: A bot that collects data from a public platform on a schedule, replacing manual lookups for a client. Keeps information consistently up to date.
projects.financeDescription: Postgraduate team project in Flutter. Tracks expenses by amount and type, filters by month and shows a breakdown by category. I helped define the app structure and guided the frontend team.
projects.travelDescription: Academic trip-planning app bringing flight, hotel and weather searches together, with Google authentication and saved trips.
